nilpotent_triple_field_transfer.theorem: Every nonzero nilpotent element of a semisimple Lie algebra over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field lies in an sl2 triple.
nilpotent_triple_field_transfer.root_data: The finite rational Cartan/root table and semisimple-centralizer steps transfer to that field.
nilpotent_triple_field_transfer.filtration: The kernel/image weight filtration is invariant under nonzero scaling and field extension; it is intrinsic over inner forms.
nilpotent_triple_field_transfer.boundary: No rational triple over a smaller field or functorial arbitrary-ring choice is asserted; group/flag and recursive global nilpotent foundations remain required.

algebraic_triple_group_integration.theorem: Every sl2 Lie algebra homomorphism into a smooth affine finite-type group over any characteristic-zero field integrates uniquely to an algebraic SL2 homomorphism.
algebraic_triple_group_integration.cocharacter: The diagonal torus gives a cocharacter with exact differential h and the exact integer weight filtration.
algebraic_triple_group_integration.boundary: A triple over the given field is an input. Parabolic classification/properness, inner-form subgroup descent and recursive global foundations remain required.

canonical_nilpotent_parabolic_and_curve_.theorem: The full intrinsic filtration scheme stabilizer is a canonical parabolic over any characteristic-zero field, including inner forms, with a projective flag quotient.
canonical_nilpotent_parabolic_and_curve_.curve: Its generic reduction extends on every smooth projective curve; reduced finite-type families have finite reduction stratifications.
canonical_nilpotent_parabolic_and_curve_.boundary: The extended special reduction need not be canonical; nonreduced-family canonical base-change, recursive global foundations and spectral regularity are not inferred.

parabolic_bundle_section_atlas_and_nilpo.theorem: Every parabolic bundle stack has an arbitrary-test projective section atlas, affine finitely presented diagonal and absolute smoothness.
parabolic_bundle_section_atlas_and_nilpo.geometry: The relative tangent complex and nilradical section cone supply dense-open chart isotropy and the nilpotent upper dimension bound.
parabolic_bundle_section_atlas_and_nilpo.boundary: The forgetting map need not be smooth; recursive global lower-dimension and spectral regularity foundations remain required.

The stronger support-only extension to all D-modules is conjectural.
